Irigenin is directly linked to this receptor, and PF-03187207, a compound that targets the receptor, is also linked to the enzyme subunit gamma. This implies a possible pathway where Irigenin may modulate the activity of PF-03187207, which in turn affects the enzyme subunit gamma. The evidence suggests a mechanistic link, but the strength of this relationship is supported by a moderate score (0.7206), indicating some level of confidence in the association. The exact nature of the interaction remains uncertain, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the proposed mechanism.
